trovato: Anthropic said the IPO was priced at $83 apiece, above its previously targeted range, raising $81 billion to claim the title of the largest stock-market debut on record. [Investing.com/Reuters] / under the ticker symbol "ANT" after markets open Thursday at 9:30 a.m. ET; start trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange. [CBS]
nota_revisore: Reuters (Investing.com) letta: 83 $, sopra la forchetta, 81 mld, record: coincide con il PDF che ora attribuisce a Reuters dek, tabella e 'Il record'. ANT, Nasdaq, giovedi 9:30 ET (=15:30 Roma) su CBS (il PDF non attribuisce questa parte a una testata; il testo Reuters letto non cita ticker ne' ora). CNBC non apribile. Nota: CBS pre-pricing scriveva 'could become the second-largest IPO ever', superato dal dato Reuters; CBS resta citata nel PDF per 956,35 mln azioni e utile/debito, coerenti con D01.

trovato: Prosus muss nach den enttäuschenden Zahlen der Beteiligung Tencent einen Kursrutsch von 5 Prozent auf den tiefsten Stand seit September 2024 verkraften. / Die wichtige chinesische Beteiligung Tencent hatte mit ihren Geschäftszahlen enttäuscht.
nota_revisore: Minimo da settembre 2024, conti deboli Tencent, quota importante coincidono; nel testo la pagina dice 5 Prozent (il 5,05% sta nella tabella).

trovato: Fed policymakers voted 10-2 to leave the federal funds rate at its target range of 3.75% to 4%. [Fox] / Two FOMC members — Fed Board Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Beth Hammack ... wanted a quarter-point increase; inflation "that has been running above the committee's objective for close to six years." [CBS]
nota_revisore: Tassi, contrari, rialzo di 25 pb, voto 10-2 e quasi sei anni confermati da Fox Business e CBS (federalreserve.gov non ritrovata).

trovato: At the Oct. 27–28 meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), policymakers voted 10-2 to keep the overnight rate at its previous 3.75%-4.00% range. / a future hike would likely be appropriate [Yahoo Finance: 'would likely be appropriate'] / some participants even noted that, if the inflation numbers got too unfavorable, they would consider a rate hike of more than a quarter-percent in December.
nota_revisore: Yahoo Finance letta: riunione 27-28 ottobre, voto 10-2, 'would likely be appropriate', 'some participants' per un rialzo oltre il quarto di punto a dicembre. Attenzione: Yahoo attribuisce il 'likely appropriate' genericamente a 'Leaders at the Federal Reserve' (non dice 'quasi tutti'; quel titolo e' di AFP/France 24, bloccata da robots, CNBC non apribile). Il PDF (pag. 1, 3, 5) e' coerente: 'alcuni piu' di un quarto di punto'.

trovato: Gold -3% to 14-month low of $3,735/oz. Dollar +0.3% to fresh 19-month high, euro below $1.10. [Reuters/MarketScreener] / silver was trading near $45.650 an ounce, down $1.619, or 3.42%; Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025; the latest published futures assessment indicating a 95.7% probability of a 25-basis-point increase. [Kitco]
nota_revisore: Oro spot -3% a 3.735 e minimo da 14 mesi (Reuters), dollaro ai massimi da 19 mesi (Reuters), argento -3,42% e 95,7% di probabilita' di rialzo a dicembre (Kitco) coincidono. Nota: il -3% e il 3.735 sono di Reuters a fine seduta, Kitco al mattino USA aveva oro a 3.777 (-1,86%) e minimo intraday 3.742,20: orari diversi mescolati, ma il fatto cita entrambe le fonti. Il PDF usa il future (3.742 $, -3,2%) nella barra e lo spot 3.735 nel box, coerente.

trovato: it will offer 980 million shares of Class A common stock priced at $83 each. The company said that 956,351,354 shares are being sold by Anthropic. The market debut is expected to value Anthropic at up to $1.5 trillion. Anthropic raked in nearly $17 billion in the third quarter this year, up 45% from the second quarter. Although Anthropic has yet to turn a profit ... Anthropic has already taken on $6.2 billion in debt.
nota_revisore: Tutti i numeri coincidono su CBS News (980 mln, 956.351.354 vendute dalla societa', fino a 1.500 mld, ~17 mld +45%, non in utile, 6,2 mld di debito). La pagina CBS non parla di base diluita e il PDF ora non lo dice. L'inferenza 'quasi tutto il ricavato va ad Anthropic' e' dichiarata nel PDF come lettura propria. CNBC non apribile.

trovato: Vanda said its initial estimate of $250 million buying from retail investors looks too conservative. Retail investors have bought a net $3 billion of Nvidia stock over the past 10 sessions. Nvidia down 2.89% at 150.96 USD, 13.11% lower over five sessions.
nota_revisore: Vanda, 3 mld, 250 mln 'prudente', Nvidia -2,9% a 150,96 e -13% in cinque sedute coincidono.

trovato: S&P 500 -0.2%, Dow -1.1%. The S&P 500 closed at 7,323.63, down 0.23%. The Dow fell 1.11%. Nasdaq +0.4%, Nasdaq Composite rose 0.42%. Five sessions: S&P 500 -3.88%, Nasdaq 100 -4.43%.
nota_revisore: Cifre coincidenti (arrotondate -3,9% e -4,4%).

trovato: some participants even noted that, if the inflation numbers got too unfavorable, they would consider a rate hike of more than a quarter-percent in December. / Fed Gov. Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack both voted in favor of a quarter-point increase. / Several of the meeting members also said it was a 'close call.' / A couple of participants noted that, at the current juncture, a gradual approach to policy firming would give businesses and households time to adjust to higher interest rates. / FOMC members also said the rapid artificial intelligence buildout was contributing to inflation.
nota_revisore: Yahoo Finance letta: 'some' per oltre un quarto di punto (condizionato a dati sfavorevoli), Cook e Hammack +0,25, 'several' close call, 'a couple' per il gradualismo (ora 'un paio' nel fatto), spesa AI. Il PDF pag. 3 (diversi: close call; alcuni: oltre un quarto di punto se l'inflazione peggiora) e' coerente. CNBC non apribile.

trovato: US yields mixed 2y +1 bp, 30y -5 bps. Average 20-year bond auction -- strong direct bid demand, weak indirects. Traders are pricing in a 90% chance of a 25 basis points hike next month, the CME FedWatch tool showed. [Yahoo]; Kitco: 95.7%.
nota_revisore: 2 anni +1, 30 anni -5, asta 20 anni e 90-95% (90% Reuters, 95,7% Kitco) coincidono.

trovato: Spot gold was trading near $3,777.00 an ounce, down $71.50, or 1.86%, fell to its lowest level since September 2025, dropping below the $3,800 level. Silver down 3.42%. The dollar index strengthened toward 103.70; renewed geopolitical uncertainty would ordinarily support defensive demand, but rate expectations, dollar strength and commodity liquidation were the stronger forces. [Kitco] Gold -3% to 14-month low of $3,735/oz. [Reuters]
nota_revisore: Sotto 3.800, minimo da settembre 2025, 3.735 per Reuters, argento -3,4%, Fed e dollaro coincidono (Bloomberg bloccata).

trovato: CMS proposes to begin extrapolating risk-adjustment audit findings with payment year 2018 ... omit a fee-for-service adjuster. Extrapolation would extend findings from a sample to a wider payment population. CMS estimates that the audit approach could collect approximately $9 billion per payment year. Public comments are due January 19, 2027; the proposal is not a final rule. [finchannel]
nota_revisore: finchannel: campione esteso a 'a wider payment population', dal 2018, senza fee-for-service adjuster, ~9 mld per anno di pagamento (la frase seguente precisa 'industry estimate, not a bill for UnitedHealth'), commenti al 19/1/2027, non regola finale. PDF pag. 4 ora coerente ('platea piu' ampia di pagamenti'). Beinsure non ritrovata.

trovato: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) shares fell 10.21% on November 18 as investors reassessed the risk... UnitedHealth closed at $349.91, down $39.77, at 4 p.m. EST. / Mizuho's Ann Hynes described greater audit scrutiny as negative for Medicare Advantage margins, identifying UnitedHealth and Humana (NYSE:HUM) as particularly exposed. [finchannel]
nota_revisore: -10,2% a 349,91 (PDF 'circa 349,9') e Mizuho 'negativo per i margini', UnitedHealth e Humana piu' esposte coincidono su finchannel. Beinsure e Investing.com non ritrovate.

trovato: The dollar index, which measures the greenback against six other currencies, was 0.1% higher at 103.92, a 19-month high. Waller said on CNBC that if the central bank wanted to get inflation down, it needed to take more "aggressive action"; The euro was at $1.0964, hovering near its lowest since April 2025.
nota_revisore: Indice 103,92, massimo da 19 mesi, Waller 'azione aggressiva', euro vicino ai minimi da aprile 2025 coincidono.

trovato: The euro was at $1.0978, hovering near its lowest since April 2025. "More hawkish Fed pricing has so far offset weakness in technology stocks, keeping the USD supported," OCBC strategists said in a note. The comments come after hotter-than-expected inflation data last week.
nota_revisore: Coincide (Investing.com ha 1,0964 a un'altra ora); il PDF usa 1,0973 (chiusura), non 1,0978.

trovato: Seduta ampiamente positiva per la Borsa di Milano: l'indice Ftse Mib ha concluso in aumento dell'1,14% a 44.944 punti.
nota_revisore: 44.944 del 30/12/2025 confermato; +11,6% da inizio anno (50.173) quadra. L'URL ANSA trovato differisce nell'hash da quello dell'incarico ma è la stessa notizia.

trovato: Headline inflation was 4% in October 2026; energy inflation rose to 20.8% from 18.9% in September; core inflation was 2.5%, unchanged from September. (intervista Lagarde a Yomiuri Shimbun, 4 novembre 2026, pubblicata 7 novembre) [BCE]
nota_revisore: Cifre 4%, 20,8%, 2,5% confermate dalla pagina BCE (riassunto, non frase letterale); 'stimata', 'massimo dal 2023' e il 4 novembre come data di uscita non letti: investingLive non ritrovata.

trovato: Nasdaq +0.4%, S&P 500 -0.2% , Dow -1.1%. / tabella: S&P 500 7,323.63 PTS -0.23%; DOW JONES INDUSTRIAL 50,198.17 PTS -1.11%; Nasdaq Composite +0.42%. [Reuters/MarketScreener]
nota_revisore: Livelli e variazioni coincidono (S&P 7.323,63 -0,23%; Dow 50.198,17 -1,11%; Nasdaq Composite +0,42%); i livelli sono nella tabella con etichetta 'Indicative Price', il testo Reuters da' solo le variazioni arrotondate. Incoerenza PDF/mercato da verificare: il PDF parla di 'cinque sedute di vendite' ma un titolo CNBC del 17/11 (visto solo nei risultati di ricerca, pagina non aperta) diceva 'S&P 500 falls for fifth day': se vero, il 18 sarebbe la sesta seduta in calo per l'S&P (il Nasdaq Composite era invece in rialzo).

trovato: schloss 0,93 Prozent tiefer bei 6.154,39 Punkten. Damit verzeichnete der Leitindex der Eurozone den vierten Verlusttag in Folge. (tabella: SAP -3,76%, ING -3,21%, Deutsche Bank -3,05%)
nota_revisore: Indice, quarto calo e i tre titoli coincidono; Prosus come N13.

trovato: Piazza Affari chiude la seduta in calo (Ftse Mib -1,32% a 50.173 punti), frenata da Leonardo (-4,08%), Tenaris (-3,13%) e Bper (-3,05%). Pochi i rialzi, limitati a Ferrari (+2,97%).
nota_revisore: Tutto coincide.

trovato: Gusmeroli, emendamento Lega per aumentare di 3 punti l'Ires alle banche. Francoforte studia l'aumento dei requisiti sulla riserva obbligatoria. ... dovrebbe tenersi nell'ambito del consiglio direttivo fissato per il prossimo 25 novembre.
nota_revisore: Letti titolo e passaggi ANSA: Ires +3 punti, riserva obbligatoria, Consiglio direttivo 25 novembre.

trovato: TJX expects comparable store sales to rise 4% in fiscal 2027, compared with its prior view of 3% to 4% growth. It also projected full-year adjusted earnings of $5.17 to $5.20 per share, sending its shares up 10% in morning trading.
nota_revisore: Tutto coincide.

trovato: The Consumer Prices Index (CPI) rose by 3.6% in the 12 months to October 2026, up from 3.5% the previous month. Diesel prices rose by 7.0 pence per litre in October 2026. This is the highest price recorded since our records began in January 1996. The core CPI annual inflation rate was 2.8% in October 2026.
nota_revisore: Coincide; il PDF dice core 'senza energia e alimentari', l'ONS esclude anche alcol e tabacco (nota minore).

trovato: I cannot tell you today that we will for sure do this in December (Lagarde, intervista a Yomiuri Shimbun, 4 novembre). Headline inflation 4%; energy 20.8%; core 2.5%.
nota_revisore: Citazione e dati confermati dalla pagina BCE; nel testo del PDF questo fatto non compare.

trovato: Brent crude futures were at $92.11 a barrel, set for a third weekly decline. In commodities, oil prices remained under pressure as the growing view that the oil market is turning to a surplus weighed.
nota_revisore: Circa 92 $, terza settimana di calo, eccesso di offerta coincidono (Yahoo: 91,47 $).

trovato: In rialzo Tokyo (+0,71%). Positive Seul (+1,02%). A contrattazioni ancora in corso scivola Hong Kong (-1,98%). Male anche Shanghai (-0,28%) e Shenzhen (-1,47%). [ANSA/l'Adige] / However, Asian equities slumped, led by Taiwanese stocks, with the Taipei benchmark index sliding 4.4%. / MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan fell 1.7% to a seven-month low. [Reuters/Investing.com]
nota_revisore: Tokyo, Seul, Hong Kong ancora in seduta, Shanghai, Shenzhen su ANSA/l'Adige e SoldiOnline; Taiwan -4,4% e indice MSCI Asia-Pacifico ex Giappone -1,7% su Reuters/Investing.com. Il PDF pag. 2 ora attribuisce Taiwan a Reuters: coerente. Il PDF non cita l'indice regionale.

trovato: 8:30 AM ET - Initial Jobless Claims: Forecast 198K, Previous 200K [Investing.com] / The weekly initial jobless claims release is scheduled for 8:30 a.m. ET (13:30 UTC). A poll of economists put the forecast at 197,000 claims. [TokenPost]
nota_revisore: 8:30 ET = 14:30 Roma, attesa 198 mila (197 mila per TokenPost), prima 200 mila (Investing.com; TokenPost non la riporta). La riga d'agenda del PDF (pag. 5: 'Gio 19, 14:30; 198 mila; prima 200 mila') coincide; il PDF non cita la stima 197 mila.
